messages:
marie: quick q — i'm seeing a short blip of 504s from us-west for /api/generate around 11:02. does anyone have the most up-to-date dashboard link and where we should grab a few traces? cc @devin :eyes:

devin: short answer: Grafana panel is under Observability -> Errors -> Timeouts by route. link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/timeouts-by-route. traces live in Tempo (https://tempo.redwood.ai) — use the span filter 'http.status_code=504' and service=frontend.

amit: fwiw, i pulled a quick promql to get 504 per route over the last 15m — useful for triage:
```promql
sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status="504"}[5m])) by (route)
```

cleo: also check the autoscaler events around that time — sometimes a drain + cold start sequence causes a small window of 504s. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/efgh5678/autoscaler-events (filter region=us-west).

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0891 (priority: low) — assigned to eng-sre oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0891

marie: thanks — i'm going to pull 3 sample traces and attach here. quick question for tuning: what threshold do we use for the 504 alert? current rule is > 0.5% of requests in 5m for any route but that noisy for routes with low qps.

devin: yep, that rule exists. recommendation: switch to a conditional alert that only fires when route_qps > 10 AND error_rate_504 > 0.5%. example expression we use in-house: 
```promql
(sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status="504"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count[5m])) by (route)) > 0.005 and sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count[5m])) by (route) > 10
```

amit: if you want a quick workaround, add a mute filter on the alert for known low-qps experimental routes (prefix: /exp/). longer-term we should switch the alert to a heatmap-based panel to visualize spikes across routes before it pages.

cleo: attaching quick checklist for triage: 1) dashboard (timeouts-by-route) 2) trace sampling (Tempo, filter 504) 3) backend latency panel (service=backend) 4) autoscaler events 5) connection pool metrics (redis/postgres)

marie: uploaded 3 traces (links): https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/aa111, https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/bb222, https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/cc333 — looks like increased backend latency + a few 502s from an internal service. i'll follow up with a PR to tighten alert conditions.

devin: perfect — if you want i can help with alert rule in prometheus-alerts repo. ping me on the PR and i'll review. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Note: Silence applied to INC-2026-0891 for experimental routes until 2026-03-17T12:30:00Z by marie.
